This figure consists of two side-by-side line charts that both share the same y-axis metric, BLEU, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5 with tick intervals of 0.1. Each chart examines the effect of a different hyperparameter on BLEU score.

The left chart shows BLEU as a function of α. The x-axis is labeled "α" with linearly spaced tick marks at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line begins at approximately 27.97 at α = 0.1, rises to about 28.3 at α = 0.3, reaches a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5, then decreases to about 28.4 at α = 0.7, and continues declining to approximately 28.12 at α = 0.9.

The right chart shows BLEU as a function of p. The x-axis is labeled "p" with linearly spaced tick marks at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line starts at approximately 28.31 at p = 0.05, rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then drops to about 28.42 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to approximately 28.47 at p = 0.35, and decreases again to about 28.43 at p = 0.45.
